units.source_text: 「我也畫啊，畫那種妖怪畫像，畫那種地獄之馬。」

en.t: I paint too, pictures of monsters, those horses of hell.

units.source_text: 不知為何，我壓低了聲音對竹一說道。

en.t: For some reason, I lowered my voice and said this to Takeichi.

units.source_text: 我從小學時就喜歡畫畫和欣賞畫，但我的畫不像作文那樣受人稱讚。

en.t: Ever since elementary school, I had liked both drawing pictures and looking at them, but my drawings were never praised the way my compositions were.

units.source_text: 因為我壓根兒就不相信人類的語言，所以作文於我而言就像搞笑的寒暄語，

en.t: Because I had never trusted human language at all, writing compositions seemed to me like a comic form of polite greeting,

units.source_text: 雖然我的作文在小學和中學能把老師們逗得笑翻，但我自己並不覺得有趣。

en.t: and although my compositions had delighted my teachers throughout elementary and middle school, I myself found them not at all amusing.

units.source_text: 唯獨繪畫（漫畫等另當別論）在物件的表現上，能用自己幼稚的自我風格去苦下一番功夫。

en.t: Only in painting, leaving aside things like cartoons, could I put some effort into representing objects in my own childish, self-taught style.
